name: review
description: Comprehensive multi-phase PR review — change analysis, 3-pass deep code review, security scanning, test analysis, and documentation-drift checks, posted as one unified GitHub review. Plus monitor-pr: continuously watch a PR for CI failures and review comments (drive with /loop), fix them via subagents in parallel, and resolve or reply-acknowledge each comment once its fix ships. Rust and Machinify mac-ui changes get tailored checks.
